chunks: My father (RA) said: Sa'd ibn Abd Allah narrated from Salamah ibn al-Khattab, from al-Qasim ibn Yahya, from his grandfather al-Hasan ibn al-Rashid, from Abu al-Hasan Musa ibn Ja'far (AS), who said:
I asked him about the meaning of Allah. He (AS) answered, “He overwhelms both the subtle and the mighty.”
ai.seo_question: What is the theological definition of the name 'Allah' according to Imam Musa ibn Ja'far?
ai.summary: Imam Musa ibn Ja'far (AS) defines the name 'Allah' as the One who possesses dominion and overwhelms all things, whether they are subtle (dqaq) or massive/manifest (jall). This definition highlights the comprehensive scope of divine power, encompassing both the microscopic and macroscopic realms, a concept central to Shia theological discussions on the attributes of God. It serves as a foundational explanation for the invocation 'Bismillah', emphasizing that all creation falls under His absolute control.
